sourceText: Operator standing directive: implement Workstream 2 of the DONE red-evidence subsystem spec section by section. W2b adds the per-story target-binding STORE (red-target-bindings.json, schema proofstory.red_target_bindings.v1, one binding per acceptanceTargetRef, createdAt-stripped targetBindingDigest, committed-tree reader) and lands red_evidence_binding_set as the subsystem's FIRST mutating CLI command, owner-lease + mutation-authority gated with the §3.3 expectedRedTargets write-time membership gate, deliberately owning the COMPLETE 13-point command-wiring recipe so the four later high-semantics commands inherit a mechanically-verified path.
normalizedOutcome: After this story lands, `lattice red_evidence_binding_set` exists as a working owner-gated CLI command: it writes exactly one binding per acceptance target into .lattice/story/actives/<id>/red-target-bindings.json, records a createdAt-stripped targetBindingDigest, rejects a duplicate target / an out-of-expectedRedTargets ref / a foreign-owner-lease caller, and the committed-tree reader resolves a binding from a git ref rather than the live directory; the three existing mechanical contracts (lifecycle-registry-contract, command-ownership-contract, verify-process-fact-contract) pass with the command fully registered at all 13 wiring points, and no existing gate verdict changes.
acceptanceClaim: The red-evidence-target-binding-smoke passes AND the three existing contracts pass: red_evidence_binding_set is registered at every wiring point, persists one-binding-per-target with the createdAt-stripped digest, resolves from the committed tree, and is rejected under a foreign owner lease / duplicate target / out-of-expectedRedTargets ref — with redEvidenceSatisfied/missingRedEvidence and every existing gate verdict unchanged.
